lines.intro: A fizzy cat pounces out of nowhere, its tail puffed up like a bottle brush!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the cat?

soothe.great: Fae hums a soft, purry tune. The cat's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The cat's ears twitch toward her.
soothe.miss: The cat is too busy chasing its own tail to listen.

play.great: Maddie and the cat touch noses, then chase a leaf together!
play.good: Maddie flicks her tail. The cat watches, curious.
play.miss: Maddie pounces... right onto a yarn ball. The cat looks very smug.

cast.great: Sue dangles her ribbon bobber. The cat bats it again and again, purring!
cast.good: Sue's bobber wiggles by. The cat crouches, wiggling too.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber snags on a bench. The cat yawns.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The cat follows every one, spellbound!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The cat's head bobs after it.
juggle.miss: A pinecone bonks Jordan on the nose. The cat flicks its tail.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. The cat nibbles it, very politely.
lines.burst: The cat puffs up and bats a flurry of yarn balls at Fae!

burstResult.good: Fae catches most of the yarn!
burstResult.miss: Whoops! Fae gets all tangled up in yarn.

lines.soothed: The cat curls up with a happy purr. The fizzy spell floats away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes away. The cat keeps swishing its tail.
